title: Kestrel and the Garden
author: Lior Sterling
blurb: Dominic Nystrom, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
